SD4100
2U 12 HDD SAS-4 Storage Expansion System


                                                             FEATURES
                                                               2U enclosure for fitment in standard 19” wide racks
                                                               Cable management assembly (CMA) not required
                                                               Up to 12 3.5” form factor drives
                                                               SAS-4 system uplink
                                                               SAS-3 or SATA-3 connectivity to drives
                                                               13W max. power per drive bay @ 35°C
                                                               Two hot-swappable expansion SAS modules (ESM)
                                                                  • Four 24G SAS-4 mini-SAS HD ports per ESM
                                                                  • One UART via USB-C
SD4100 is an economical 2U 12 drive                          POWER AND COOLING
bay enterprise-class SAS-4storage                              Two power efficient 800W CRPS PSUs
expansion platform with redundant                              (Lot-9 Compliant)
architecture for greater data availability.                    100-127,200-240V AC input

It offers flexible, easy deployment, ideal                     Three 40mm dual-rotor fans per ESM

for both small businesses and large                          PHYSICAL DIMENSIONS

enterprises that require a high level of                       Height: 87 mm (2U)

efficiency and performance.                                    Width: 446 mm
                                                               Depth: 545 mm

The SD4100 is ideal for:                                     ENVIRONMENTAL

• Backup and Recovery                                          Operating Temperature: 5°C to 35°C

• Data Replication                                             Non-operating Temperature: -40°C to 60°C

• Scalable Software-Defined-Storage                            Humidity: 8% to 80% RH

• Archive Storage                                              Altitude: 0 to 950 m (De-rate temperature 1°C per
                                                               300 m above 950 m)
                                                               Sound Power: (23+/-2°C) <7.6Bel




                                      Enterprise-Class Quality. Cloud Economics.

North America: (Toll Free) +1 888 899 9998   |   Global: +1 416 448 5800   |   contactus@celestica.com   |   celestica.com
